title: Claude Certified Architect Prep: A Free Unofficial Kit (Not by Anthropic)
subtitle: An unofficial study guide PDF, 200 mock exam questions and a Windows practice app to prepare for the CCA-F exam. Not official, not provided by Anthropic.
captions: The disclaimer: not official, not provided by Anthropic
The exam at a glance: format, scenarios, scoring and the five domains
The three files: study guide PDF, mock exams PDF and practice app
Inside the study guide: domain weights and annotated code
Patterns, architecture diagrams and real settings files
The mock exams workbook: questions grouped by scenario, and answer keys
The Windows app: start the practice app or open the PDF in one click
The practice app home page: exam format, domain weights and two modes
Practice mode: why the answer is wrong, the correct answer and the explanation
Timed mode: a 40-minute timer and a question navigator
Results: estimated scaled score, score per domain and review of misses
